title: Roku Hikes Hardware Prices by Up to 60%
summary: The biggest increases are for Roku’s flagship devices — the Roku Ultra and Streambar SE — which will increase in price from $100 to $150. Meanwhile, the popular Roku Streaming Stick 4K now costs 60% more, at $80.
